product.name: FireMaximizer
product.whatItIs: Multiband maximizer and limiter audio effect plugin

readerFacingCopy.title: UnitedPlugins - FireMaximizer
readerFacingCopy.summary: UnitedPlugins offers the FireMaximizer plugin for free using a promotional coupon code until October 18, 2026.
readerFacingCopy.body: FireMaximizer is a multiband limiter and maximizer plugin designed for mastering and bus processing. It combines dynamic control and saturation functions. The plugin is available at no cost during a limited-time promotional offer on the official website.

evidence.name: UnitedPlugins Official Store
evidence.fact: Official product page allowing $0 checkout with a promotional coupon code.

evidence.name: Greg Kocis - YouTube
evidence.fact: Video announcing FireMaximizer free until October 18 with a creator coupon code.

restrictions: Requires applying a valid promotional coupon code at checkout.
openQuestions: What is the exact expiration time and timezone on October 18, 2026?
toValidate: Confirm whether an iLok user account is required for license activation.

product.name: Pigments Play
product.whatItIs: Software synthesizer instrument featuring preset playback and six synthesis engines

readerFacingCopy.title: Arturia - Pigments Play
readerFacingCopy.summary: Arturia has released Pigments Play, a free freeware edition of its Pigments synthesizer.
readerFacingCopy.body: Pigments Play is a free virtual instrument from Arturia that includes 100 factory presets and access to six synthesis engines, including Virtual Analog, Wavetable, Sample, Granular, Harmonic, and Modal.

evidence.name: Arturia Official Web Page
evidence.fact: Official product page offering Pigments Play as a free software download.

evidence.name: AnDerington - YouTube
evidence.fact: Video showcasing Pigments Play as a new free virtual instrument.

restrictions: Requires an Arturia user account and installation via Arturia Software Center.
toValidate: Check whether user-purchased expansion sound banks for full Pigments can be loaded into Pigments Play.

product.name: AirXciter
product.whatItIs: High-frequency audio exciter plugin for vocal and mix bus processing

readerFacingCopy.title: Audio Toolshed - AirXciter
readerFacingCopy.summary: Audio Toolshed offers AirXciter as a free audio exciter plugin for vocal and master bus enhancement.
readerFacingCopy.body: AirXciter is a psychoacoustic processor plugin that adds high-frequency presence and clarity to vocal tracks and mix buses without introducing harshness.

evidence.name: Audio Toolshed Official Website
evidence.fact: Official product page listing AirXciter as a free software download.

evidence.name: Audio Toolshed - YouTube
evidence.fact: Video overview demonstrating high-frequency processing features of AirXciter.

toValidate: Test supported plugin formats (VST3, AU, AAX) on macOS and Windows operating systems.

product.name: Kaset
product.whatItIs: Cassette tape saturation and analog coloration audio effect plugin

readerFacingCopy.title: SubverseLab - Kaset
readerFacingCopy.summary: SubverseLab offers its Kaset tape saturation plugin for free to the first 1,000 users.
readerFacingCopy.body: Kaset is an analog tape saturation plugin that models cassette tape coloration for individual audio tracks or the main mix bus. The developer is offering free downloads limited to the first 1,000 producers.

evidence.name: SubverseLab Official Launch Page
evidence.fact: Official page stating the plugin is free for the first 1,000 users.

evidence.name: FREE PLUGINS FREE - YouTube
evidence.fact: Video highlighting the 1,000-license launch promotion for Kaset.

restrictions: Limited to the first 1,000 redeemed licenses.
openQuestions: How many licenses remain unclaimed from the initial 1,000 quota?
toValidate: Attempt checkout on the launch page to verify whether the 1,000 free license threshold has been reached.

product.name: RC909 Pro
product.whatItIs: Virtual drum machine plugin based on the Roland TR-909

readerFacingCopy.title: SampleScience - RC909 Pro
readerFacingCopy.summary: SampleScience offers the RC909 Pro virtual drum machine for free with a coupon code.
readerFacingCopy.body: RC909 Pro is a virtual drum machine plugin modeled after the Roland TR-909. It features individual sound controls, envelope shaping, and built-in saturation effects. Users can acquire it for $0 using coupon code free909drums at checkout.

evidence.name: SampleScience Store on Gumroad
evidence.fact: Official store page allowing a $30 discount with coupon code free909drums.

evidence.name: Plugin Librarian - YouTube
evidence.fact: Video confirming the vendor-wide coupon code for a free download.

restrictions: Requires applying coupon code free909drums at checkout.
openQuestions: What is the exact expiration time and timezone on October 31, 2026?
toValidate: Verify whether there is a limit on redemptions per user account.

readerFacingCopy.title: Sonic Labs Audio - The Josie TD3
readerFacingCopy.summary: Sonic Labs Audio provides The Josie TD3 compressor plugin for free for a limited time.
readerFacingCopy.body: The Josie TD3 is a dynamic compressor audio plugin designed for transient shaping and bus compression. It is temporarily available at no cost instead of its regular $29 list price.

evidence.name: Free Plugin Wala - YouTube
evidence.fact: Video stating a limited-time free promotion ($29 to $0) for The Josie TD3 plugin.
